agent_profiles_limits.name: agent_profiles_limits
agent_profiles_limits.value: ("agent_profiles"."max_duration_ms" IS NULL OR "agent_profiles"."max_duration_ms" > 0) AND ("agent_profiles"."max_cost_micros" IS NULL OR "agent_profiles"."max_cost_micros" > 0)

members_identity.name: members_identity
members_identity.value: ("members"."kind" = 'person' AND "members"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("members"."kind" = 'agent' AND "members"."user_id" IS NULL)
